paper.title: MobileSteward: Integrating Multiple App-Oriented Agents with Self-Evolution to Automate Cross-App Instructions
paper.central_claim: 提出自演化多智能体框架 MobileSteward：中心 StewardAgent（Dynamic Recruitment 生成调度图、Adjusted Evaluation 反思/传递信息）+ 多个 App 专属 StaffAgent（Assigned Execution），并以 Memory-based Self-evolution 从成功执行中累积 Staff Expertise / Task Guideline 记忆；在新建 CAPBench(500 条跨 App 指令)上优于单/多智能体基线。

provenance.session_receipt_note: worker has no session/receipt handle exposed; model name taken from system prompt
provenance.blind_boundary_note: No seat/aggregate/archive/old score read. research/patterns/assignments.jsonl was only grepped as a queue hint (truncated lines for 5 of 6 papers were displayed); its fit notes were not used as evidence and all pattern calls below were made from full text.

missing_sections: Figures (captions only); Fig. 5/6 numbers not in text

sections_read: Abstract/§1 grep for workflow induction; lineage only
missing_sections: reference paper read only by targeted grep for gap/lineage; not a full review

evidence.quote: existing procedure-oriented agents struggle with cross-app instructions, due to the following challenges: (1) complex task relationships, (2) diverse app environment, and (3) error propagation and information loss in multi-step execution.
evidence.support_explanation: 作者 gap：跨 App 指令的三类困难

evidence.quote: Although MobileAgent-v2 ( 51 ) follows the procedure-oriented idea to combine the Planning Agent, Decision Agent, and Reflection Agent at each execution step, its performance in solving cross-app instructions is still unsatisfactory.
evidence.support_explanation: 最近邻 MobileAgent-v2 及其局限（作者陈述）

evidence.quote: StewardAgent splits the instruction into app-oriented tasks and recruits related StaffAgents, then establishes the information flow among tasks to generate the scheduling graph.
evidence.support_explanation: Dynamic Recruitment：按 App 分解+信息流调度图

evidence.quote: The scheduling graph generated in the Dynamic Recruitment phase is a DAG, so we use topological sorting on the scheduling graph to assign tasks
evidence.support_explanation: 调度图为 DAG，拓扑排序执行

evidence.quote: We adopt the AppAgent ( 25 ) to build StaffAgent, simplifying the action space as shown in the Table 1 .

evidence.quote: we emphasize its proficiency in that app and add a app description in the role-playing prompt
evidence.support_explanation: App 专属化主要靠角色提示+记忆

evidence.quote: StewardAgent evaluates the StaffAgent’s execution, provides reflection tips for errors or summarizes the results of correct execution to deliver the information and adjust the subsequent schedule.
evidence.support_explanation: Adjusted Evaluation：Steward 对执行历史做评估/反思/结果传递

evidence.quote: After StaffAgent successfully completes an assigned task, StewardAgent will summarize the execution process, extract the staff expertise and task guidelines, and update the memory.
evidence.support_explanation: 记忆写入仅在 Steward 判定成功后

evidence.quote: In total, we constructed 500 cross-app instructions
evidence.support_explanation: CAPBench 规模

evidence.quote: we randomly select 2-4 apps from the candidate apps, and then prompt GPT-4 with the app information to analyze the existence of reasonable task associations and information transfer among the apps

gap.author_gap: 现有手机 agent 擅长单 App，跨 App 指令因任务关系复杂、App 环境多样、多步误差传播/信息丢失而失败（S001）。
gap.checked_gap: 缺口存在且由基线在新基准上的近零 SR（AppAgent 0.00、MobileAgent 0.01，S017）体现，但基准由作者构建，缺口大小依赖 CAPBench 设计。最近邻 MobileAgent-v2 被比较；记忆演化近邻（MobileGPT、AutoDroid、AppAgent 文档）被提及，固定最近邻 AWM（先于本文，S035）从成功经验归纳工作流入记忆，本文未引用/比较。

lineage.closest_adjacent: MobileAgent-v2（流程导向）；AWM (2409.07429) 的工作流归纳记忆。

gap.residue: 跨 App 长程任务的信息传递与恢复在基线上几乎为 0；残余在于评估可靠性与记忆的泛化。
gap.stakes: 用户跨 App 请求是真实刚需；错误评估会污染记忆。
gap.method_response: 按 App 对象化分工、显式信息流 DAG、阶段性评估与记忆。
gap.remaining_gap: Steward 评估准确率；记忆跨 App/跨基准泛化；与带记忆基线（如 AWM 类）的公平对比；弱模型下的退化。
unresolved: 成功判定方式；CAPBench 与其他基准的重叠；AWM 类基线未比较

assessment.reproduction_note: 全部为作者报告；本席仅核对表内算术。

G.reason: 跨 App 指令是真实且未解的缺口，三类困难清楚，并以基线近零 SR 体现（S017）；最近邻 MobileAgent-v2 被比较，经验记忆近邻被提及。扣分：缺口量级依赖作者自建基准；固定近邻 AWM 的记忆归纳路线未被讨论（S035）；与 Mobile-Agent-E 等同期近邻未涉及。介于 2 与 4。

M.reason: 对象化分工（按 App）、显式信息流 DAG、阶段性评估、成功经验入记忆，与三类困难一一对位（S003/S004/S007/S008），且给出可检验预测（App 数增加时优势扩大，S025）。扣分：App 专属化主要靠提示+记忆而非不同能力；评估依赖未经验证的 LLM 自评；弱基座反例（S026）。逻辑可检验、假设未验证。=3。

X.reason: 算法与动作空间、参数（N_try=3、20 步）、检索（BM25 top-3）已给出；但无附录/提示词、App 描述与专长初始内容、记忆更新准则（“是否更新”如何判）、记忆淘汰与容量、失败时的回退/停止条件细节均缺（S034）。=2。

E.measurement.reason: 成功率/Task/App Rate 有定义，但“指令是否完成”由谁判定、如何判定在全文无报告（S015/S034），CAPBench 真值由作者模板+GPT-4+人工筛选；他人基准数值为外部转引（S029）。无法评估验证器可信度。=1。

E.causality.reason: 有模块消融（S022-S024）且方向一致，招募随 App 数/基座的分析（S025）。但：基线无同类记忆且步预算/基座不一（S014、S018、S020）；表3“完整行”与表2 不一致（S020/S021）；“w/o”定义缺；调度图本身未被消融；自演化专长≈手写仅文字陈述（S027）。替代解释未排除。=2。

E.holdout.reason: 记忆由同基准、同 14 个 App、同模板的其余指令构建，且测试期继续更新（S010/S012）；无不相交 App 或跨基准的留出；MobileAgentBench/在线用户集的记忆状态不明。=1。

E.statistics.reason: 给出测试分母（150）、复杂度分层；单次温度 0 运行，无方差；消融差距仅 7-28 个任务；无失败原因分层。=1。

E.cost.reason: 报告每任务动作数与每动作 token 对 MobileAgent-v2 更低（S030/S031）；但在 MobileAgentBench 上 IOT 为表内最高（S028），无墙钟/美元，基线预算不等。=2。
